## 介绍练习

### 1

```{R}
library(UsingR)
data("father.son", package = "UsingR")
head(father.son)
mean(father.son$sheight)
```

### 2

```{R}
data("father.son", package = "UsingR")

# 筛选父亲身高四舍五入后等于71英寸的儿子身高
son_heights <- father.son$sheight[
  round(father.son$fheight) == 71
]

# 查看筛选后的身高列表
son_heights

# 计算平均身高
mean(son_heights)
```
